notes:
Crash fix: talk2me no longer crashes when another app puts a very large clipboard (thousands of files) in place during a dictation. A clipboard too large to copy and put back is left alone, with a clear message.
The last dictation stays on the clipboard of this Mac, so Command-V pastes it again if the focus moved to another window. On by default; turn it off in Settings.
Home: a gear for Settings, a Languages line with your languages, and "100% private" under the title. Send feedback is now the last item in Advanced.
